# CUTIBACTERIUM (FORMERLY PROPIONIBACTERIUM) SPECIES

Isolation of Cutibacterium species from a culture often represents contamination or colonization and not disease. For questions about whether a patient should be treated, contact Infectious Diseases.

Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See disease/syndrome sections for more information.

[Acne and Rosacea](acne)
